messages:
sophie: Quick a11y pass on /console/metrics (NVDA + keyboard). Found 4 small things: 1) contrast issues on secondary chart labels (~2.8:1), 2) primary CTA loses focus outline when using the new button component, 3) datepicker traps tab focus, 4) chart slices lack accessible names. Repro steps + snippets below.

jon: Thanks — great catch. Can you paste repro steps and the CSS you saw for the button? :eyes:

sophie: Repro steps:
1) Keyboard only: open Console > Dashboards > Usage
2) Tab to the timeframe picker (date range), open it with Enter
3) Press Tab repeatedly — focus stays inside popup even after closing with Esc sometimes
4) Use NVDA to inspect charts — screen reader reads "graphic" but no labels.

sophie: Button CSS that's removing outline:
```
.btn-primary { box-shadow: none; outline: none; }
.btn-primary:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0); }
```
That `box-shadow: 0` rule kills visible rings. Also many secondary labels are `#9aa0a6` on white, which hits ~2.8:1.

maria: Oof. For the datepicker, is it a custom popup or a 3p lib? We might need to add `aria-modal` or manage `inert` on the background.

sophie: It's a small custom widget. I think we need to:
- Restore focus ring with `:focus-visible` or at minimum `:focus` styles
- Ensure the picker sets `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"` and traps focus only when open, but releases it reliably on close
- Add `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` to each chart slice (e.g., `role="img" aria-label="Requests: 43% (avg latency 120ms)"`).

sam: For contrast, can we darken those labels to `#6b6f73`? That should get us to ~4.6:1. Also add a token for `text-muted-contrast` so designers can opt in.

jon: Agreed on tokens. On focus styles, avoid heavy outlines — we prefer a 3px solid accent ring with `outline-offset: 2px` in the system token. Also add `:focus:not(:focus-visible) { outline: none; }` to avoid mouse focus.

sophie: One more nit — `aria-live` region used for streaming logs in the console is `polite`, but NVDA announces every token update. Suggest switching to batching updates and using `aria-atomic="true"` or `aria-relevant="additions text"` carefully. The live region currently floods screen reader.

a11y-bot: Automated contrast check failed for 3 elements: `.chart-label--muted`, `.table .cell--secondary`, `.btn-tertiary:hover` — see CI details: https://ci.internal/reports/a11y/1781456123

maria: Thanks all. Action items:
- Eng: fix focus ring in button tokens + restore visible focus (jon, sam)
- Eng: add aria labels to chart slices and ensure role="img" (jon)
- Eng: datepicker: role=dialog, proper trap/release (sam)
- Design: update text-muted token and provide color tokens (maria)
- QE: validate NVDA + VoiceOver passes after changes (sophie)

jon: I'll pick up button + chart labels. Will open PR with screenshots and NVDA notes. ETA EOD tomorrow.

sophie: Thanks — added a short checklist to the UX board card and attached the code snippet.

sam: :thumbsup:
